# Root certificates baked into the console builds.
#
# One label per line, matched exactly against the labels Mozilla's bundle uses
# (the line above the ==== rule in cacert.pem). Blank lines and # comments are
# ignored. mkbundle.sh fails if a label here is not in the upstream bundle,
# because a root that quietly vanished is a build that quietly stops trusting a
# server somebody uses.
#
# Why a list and not the whole bundle: curl creates a fresh easy handle per
# request and mbedTLS parses the entire CA file for each one. All 121 roots is
# ~185 KB of PEM to base64 decode and ASN.1 parse on a 268 MHz ARM11, on every
# single request of a sync that makes one per title. This list is the CAs a
# self hosted server is actually likely to use, and it is a third of the size.
#
# Anything not here is still reachable: `ca_bundle` in config.txt points at a
# file on the card and takes priority over this. That is also the answer for a
# private CA, which by definition cannot be in a list shipped to everybody.

# Let's Encrypt. The default answer for a self hosted server with a domain.
ISRG Root X1
ISRG Root X2

# Google Trust Services. Also what Cloudflare's free certificates chain to.
GTS Root R1
GTS Root R3
GTS Root R4

# GlobalSign, including the roots GTS cross signs against.
GlobalSign Root CA - R3
GlobalSign Root CA - R6
GlobalSign Root R46
GlobalSign Root E46
GlobalSign ECC Root CA - R4
GlobalSign ECC Root CA - R5

# DigiCert.
DigiCert Global Root G2
DigiCert Global Root G3
DigiCert Trusted Root G4
DigiCert TLS ECC P384 Root G5
DigiCert TLS RSA4096 Root G5

# Sectigo, which is what ZeroSSL and most cheap certificates chain to.
USERTrust RSA Certification Authority
USERTrust ECC Certification Authority
Sectigo Public Server Authentication Root R46
Sectigo Public Server Authentication Root E46

# Amazon, for a server behind ACM or CloudFront.
Amazon Root CA 1
Amazon Root CA 2
Amazon Root CA 3
Amazon Root CA 4
Starfield Services Root Certificate Authority - G2

# The other ACME issuers a person can get a free certificate from.
Buypass Class 2 Root CA
Buypass Class 3 Root CA
Certainly Root R1
Certainly Root E1
Actalis Authentication Root CA
SSL.com TLS RSA Root CA 2022
SSL.com TLS ECC Root CA 2022
Certum Trusted Root CA
Certum EC-384 CA

# Microsoft, for a server fronted by Azure.
Microsoft RSA Root Certificate Authority 2017
Microsoft ECC Root Certificate Authority 2017
